unsupported: The store carries cotton, knit jersey, rayon, and exclusive Hawaiian-print fabrics sold by the yard and as pre-cut scraps.

It also runs block-printing workshops where participants create custom designs, offers a start-up support service for craft entrepreneurs, and produces original items such as dog apparel, furoshiki gift wraps, and fabric scrap bundles.
Customers include hobbyist quilters, sewists, home-decor makers, and small craft businesses.
